meta.name: analyzing-azure-activity-logs-for-threats
meta.description: Queries Azure Monitor activity logs and sign-in logs via azure-monitor-query to detect suspicious administrative operations, impossible travel, privilege escalation, and resource modifications. Builds KQL queries for threat hunting in Azure environments. Use when investigating suspicious Azure tenant activity or building cloud SIEM detections.

copy.tagline: 查询 Azure 活动日志，检测可疑操作和威胁
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析 Azure 日志来发现安全威胁
copy.tagline_en: Query Azure activity logs to detect suspicious operations and threats
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze Azure logs for security threats

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询 Azure 活动日志和登录日志，检测可疑管理操作、不可能旅行、权限提升和资源修改，并生成 KQL 查询用于威胁狩猎。
howto.when: 当需要调查 Azure 租户的可疑活动或构建云 SIEM 检测规则时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下过去24小时Azure中所有角色分配变更。
say.note: Claude 会执行 KQL 查询并返回结果。

say.text: 检测是否有来自新IP的密钥保管库访问。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query Azure activity logs and sign-in logs to detect suspicious admin operations, impossible travel, privilege escalation, and resource modifications, and generate KQL queries for threat hunting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when investigating suspicious Azure tenant activity or building cloud SIEM detection rules.

say_en.text: Check all role assignment changes in Azure for the past 24 hours.
say_en.note: Claude will execute a KQL query and return results.

say_en.text: Detect Key Vault secret access from new IPs.
say_en.note: Claude will build and run the relevant query.
